posts.author: Junior63
posts.text: Har kopiert dette (håper jeg får tilgivelse ☺️) fra Hegnar forum. Var ei flott oppsummering fra Prosafe,s opptreden på Olje og gass messa.  KILDE: skrevet av skribent: Braastad «Oppsummering fra Pareto konferansen;  Prosafe  CEO Reese McNeel  • Prosafe sees a tight market, with overall utilization at its highest level in many years. With more FPSOs coming online over the coming years, visibility also remains good  • With multiple rigs rolling off contract in Brazil next year, both from Prosafe and its competitors, tendering activity is expected to remain high. Following the increase in dayrates seen over the past few years, the company hopes to recontract its fleet at substantially higher rates than current contracts  • There are still multiple single-asset owners in the sector, and the company sees clear potential to consolidate a fragmented market going forward.»
